cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box our allotment photo, label that summer properly. It wasn't three months wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three carrots is the yield. We got up every morning to water them together. Don't reduce the whole record to the harvest figure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. When someone asks about it, start with those mornings. Give them the full account before you get to the three carrots.
